title: Kadhal
desc: Aishwarya, a young student from a wealthy family, falls in love with Murugan, a scooter mechanic. She convinces him to elope with her, but things take a drastic turn when her family tracks them down.

title: Kadal Meengal
desc: A fisherman returns from sea after being presumed dead. However, unaware that his lover has given birth to their son, he marries another after failing to find her.

title: Senkoattai
desc: Thirumoorthy is a corrupt politician who plans to kill the prime minister as he lusts after his position. However, Sekhar, a young police officer, creates hurdles in his path.

title: Sandamarutham
desc: An undercover cop works to stop a dangerous criminal from selling deadly chemical to terrorists, racing against the clock to save countless lives.
